import csv
from decimal import Decimal

# Define invoice data extracted from PDFs
invoices_data = {
    '002071': {
        'vendor': 'Delta Studio Supply',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Archive cartons, reinforced - batch 2', 'qty': '9', 'unit_price': '12.45', 'line_amount': '112.05'},
            {'description': 'Labels "Handle with care", roll 2', 'qty': '3', 'unit_price': '10.80', 'line_amount': '32.40'},
            {'description': 'Cut-to-length protective liner, grade 2', 'qty': '2.5', 'unit_price': '14.76', 'line_amount': '36.90'},
            {'description': 'Returned labels credit, order 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-9.80', 'line_amount': '-9.80'},
        ],
        'subtotal': '171.55',
        'tax': '22.17',
        'total': '193.72'
    },
    '002082': {
        'vendor': 'Elm Fabrication Ltd',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Bench assembly, series 2', 'qty': '2', 'unit_price': '1262.60', 'line_amount': '2525.20'},
            {'description': 'Alignment service, station 2', 'qty': '1.5', 'unit_price': '86.40', 'line_amount': '129.60'},
            {'description': 'Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 2, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', 'qty': '3', 'unit_price': '49.75', 'line_amount': '149.25'},
            {'description': 'Precision shims, pack 2', 'qty': '7', 'unit_price': '4.375', 'line_amount': '30.63'},
            {'description': 'Freight and handling, zone 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '42.50', 'line_amount': '42.50'},
            {'description': 'Volume discount, agreement 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-36.00', 'line_amount': '-36.00'},
        ],
        'subtotal': '2841.18',
        'tax': '154.28',
        'total': '2995.46'
    },
    '002093': {
        'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Site survey, area 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '448.50', 'line_amount': '448.50'},
            {'description': 'Travel time, route 2', 'qty': '2.25', 'unit_price': '64.80', 'line_amount': '145.80'},
            {'description': 'Calibration standard, set 2', 'qty': '2', 'unit_price': '37.25', 'line_amount': '74.50'},
            {'description': 'Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', 'qty': '4', 'unit_price': '18.95', 'line_amount': '75.80'},
            {'description': 'Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', 'qty': '5', 'unit_price': '11.40', 'line_amount': '57.00'},
            {'description': 'Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-26.00', 'line_amount': '-26.00'},
        ],
        'subtotal': '775.60',
        'tax': '90.64',
        'total': '866.26'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    writer.writeheader()
    
    for invoice_id, invoice_data in invoices_data.items():
        vendor = invoice_data['vendor']
        for item in invoice_data['items']:
            writer.writerow({
                'invoice_id': invoice_id,
                'vendor': vendor,
                'description': item['description'],
                'quantity': item['qty'],
                'unit_price': item['unit_price'],
                'line_amount': item['line_amount']
            })

print("items.csv created successfully")

# Perform reconciliation using Decimal for precision
reconciliation = []

for invoice_id, invoice_data in invoices_data.items():
    # Calculate subtotal from line items using Decimal
    computed_subtotal = Decimal('0')
    for item in invoice_data['items']:
        computed_subtotal += Decimal(item['line_amount'])
    
    # Get printed values
    printed_subtotal = Decimal(invoice_data['subtotal'])
    tax = Decimal(invoice_data['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(invoice_data['total'])
    
    # Compute total (subtotal + tax)
    computed_total = computed_subtotal + tax
    
    # Calculate difference
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    # Determine status
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': str(computed_subtotal),
        'tax': str(tax),
        'printed_total': str(printed_total),
        'computed_total': str(computed_total),
        'difference': str(difference),
        'status': status
    })
    
    # Report discrepancies
    if status == 'discrepancy':
        print(f"DISCREPANCY found in invoice {invoice_id}: difference = {difference}")

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(reconciliation)

print("reconciliation.csv created successfully")

# Summary
print("\nReconciliation Summary:")
for rec in reconciliation:
    print(f"Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: {rec['status']}")
EOF
